items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...they told Zutty you know, how kind he had been... But Zuttv did [listen to Mel].

ctx.x: Yes, Mel Epstien. And they were so crazy about Zutty because they told Zutty you know, how kind he had been and all. And nobody else would listen to Mel, to Mel as a jazz piano player.
